whoosh-short.description: Subtle, short whoosh. Ideal for fast movements, slide transitions, or quick character actions.

whoosh-cinematic.description: Deeper, more sweeping whoosh. Ideal for cinematic camera moves, shifts in tone, or abstract transitions.

riser.description: Gradual tension riser. Perfect for building drama, anxiety, or leading up to a major reveal.

impact-bass-1.description: Heavy bass hit. Best for sudden shocking statements, dark warnings, or scientific graph spikes.

impact-bass-2.description: Deep resonance bass impact. Used for locking in core discoveries, psychologist name reveals, or closing arguments.

glitch-1.description: Disruption or record-scratch analog effect. Great for ironic turns, rude waiter scenarios, or mental blockages.

notification.description: Modern phone ping swarm. Best for representing digital distraction, emails, or social media notifications.

chime.description: Bright crystal chime. Excellent for positive realizations, 'superpower' claims, or happy brain structures.

sparkle.description: Shimmering, hopeful finish sound. Ideal for concluding slides, calls to action, or end screens.

cash-register.description: Classic register ring and cha-ching sound. Ideal for money, grants, funding, or transactional moments.

clock-ticking.description: Close-up analog clock ticking. Ideal for build-up, passing of time, deadlines, or historical pacing.

anime-wow.description: Meme high-pitched vocal wow expression. Ideal for surprises, highlights, or comedic realizations.
